GeoBrix · raster-genie example

Raster is ready for Genie and SQL warehouses.

Land master COGs in a FILE table, read them with GeoBrix functions in Unity Catalog SQL, and ask a Genie Agent in plain English. The agent composes the functions into one SQL statement per answer.
